typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DestinationFileName_Prefix as string (),
	DestinationFileName_Sufix as string (),
	DestinationFullPath as string (),
	DestinationPath as string (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	Email_Recipients_cc as string (),
	FIRSTRUN_DT as timestamp (),
	Getdatepart as string (),
	GRGR_CK as string (),
	RUNDATE as timestamp (),
	V_Noofrecords as integer ()
}

source(output(
		MRSS_MEMBER_ID as string,
		MRSS_MEMBER_LNAME as string,
		MRSS_MEMBER_FNAME as string,
		MRSS_PROV_CONTACT_TYPE as string,
		MRSS_CONTACT_DATE as string,
		MRSS_CRISIS as string,
		MRSS_DATE_CREATED as timestamp,
		MRSS_CONTACT_NOTES as string,
		MRSS_NARRATIVE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT  MRSS_MEMBER_ID			 ,MRSS_MEMBER_LNAME		 ,MRSS_MEMBER_FNAME		 ,MRSS_PROV_CONTACT_TYPE	 ,MRSS_CONTACT_DATE		 ,MRSS_CRISIS				 ,MRSS_DATE_CREATED		 ,MRSS_CONTACT_NOTES		 ,MRSS_NARRATIVE	 FROM [EXTRACT].MMC_MRSS_EXTRACT (NOLOCK) WHERE LAST_PROCESSED_DT = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCMMCMRSSEXTRACT
OLESRCMMCMRSSEXTRACT split(V_Noofrecords == 0,greaterOrEqual(V_Noofrecords,1), disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,Case2,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
OLESRCMMCMRSSEXTRACT aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
ConditionalSplit@Case2 sink(input(
		DATE_CREATED as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_FNAME as string,
		MRSS_CONTACT_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		CRISIS as string,
		CONTACT_NOTES as string,
		MEMBER_LNAME as string,
		PROV_CONTACT_TYPE as string,
		NARRATIVE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DATE_CREATED = MRSS_DATE_CREATED,
		MEMBER_FNAME = MRSS_MEMBER_FNAME,
		MRSS_CONTACT_DATE,
		MEMBER_ID = MRSS_MEMBER_ID,
		CRISIS = MRSS_CRISIS,
		CONTACT_NOTES = MRSS_CONTACT_NOTES,
		MEMBER_LNAME = MRSS_MEMBER_LNAME,
		PROV_CONTACT_TYPE = MRSS_PROV_CONTACT_TYPE,
		NARRATIVE = MRSS_NARRATIVE)) ~> FFDSTMMCMRSSEXTRACT
